title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist
description:
Overview:

If you think CRO is just changing button colors to green, running \"best practice\" listicles you copied from a competitor, or obsessing over Conversion Rate instead of Revenue Per Session—do not apply.

At EcomExperts.io, we don't do \"website redesigns\" based on feelings. We don't do \"funnel jacking.\" We do Evolutionary Redesign based on the Billion Dollar Data Funnel.


We are looking for a Senior CRO Strategist who understands that a website is simply a domain that visually presents an Offer and communicates UVPs through Copywriting and Creative. Your job is to close the gap between the Actual Customer Journey and the Optimal Customer Journey.


Who You Are:

  • You are a Detective, not a Guesser: You know that demographics get the click, but psychographics win the sale. You don't move a pixel until you've analyzed the \"Raw Data\" and listened to the customer.
  • You Design for the \"Gator\": You understand that 95% of purchasing decisions are subconscious. You know how to feed the Gator clarity and only wake up the \"Judge\" when it's time to validate specs and reviews.
  • You Hate \"Conversion Rate\": You know it's a vanity metric. You optimize for Revenue Per Session (RPS), Element Revenue Per Session (eRPS), and Contribution Margin.
  • You Don't \"Test Everything\": You prioritize ruthlessly using the ICE Framework (Impact, Confidence, Ease). You only run tests that matter.


What You Will Do (The 6-Step Data Loop):

  • Deep Research: You will run the full data funnel. You'll analyze Customer Feedback Surveys (asking \"What/How,\" not \"Yes/No\"), conduct Competitor Analysis via the 5 Pillars (Offer, UVP, Copy, Creative, UX), and dive into Revenue-Based Heatmaps.
  • Hypothesis Generation: You will write hypotheses that actually mean something. Formula: \"Because of (Insight), if we change (Variable), (Metric) will increase by (X)% for (Segment).
  • The 5 Pillars Audit: You will constantly audit client sites to find the weakest pillar—whether it's a weak Offer, a confusing UX, or a Hero Section that fails the \"1-Second Test.
  • est Design: You will design A/B, Multivariate, and Reverse A/B tests. You will ensure we hit 95% Statistical Significance and maintain a \"Do No Harm\" approach.
  • Evolutionary Redesign: You will systematically upgrade our clients' sites—from PDPs to PLPs to Homepages—without ever needing a risky \"Big Bang\" relaunch.
  • ntel Over Wins: Even if a test loses, you extract the intel. You understand that learning why something failed is just as valuable as a revenue lift.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years in CRO or high-level E-com Strategy.
  • Mastery of the 5 Pillars of a Website (Offer, UVP, Copy, Creative, UX). Deep experience with GA4, Heatmaps (Revenue-based preferred), and Screen Recordings.
  • bility to spot Friction, Flow, and Focus in user session recordings.
  • trong copywriting skills—you know how to write a \"Dream Outcome\" headline and a \"How\" sub-headline.


Bonus: You know why \"Funnel Jacking\" is a waste of time and why \"Quick Wins\" are a myth (mostly).


This position is a full-time remote opportunity with hours from Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm EST.

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting
  • Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development
  • Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis
  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster
  • Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbers


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial
  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling
  • AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how
  • Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models
  • You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send
  • Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holding


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature
  • Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similar


ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.

title: Backend Cloud Engineer — AWS Serverless (Remote)
description:
About EverUp

We’re a UK startup making gift-card shopping rewarding. Our mobile app (React Native) and web (React) run on a serverless AWS backend. We’re hiring a Backend Cloud Engineer to evolve and maintain the APIs, databases, and services that power payments, wallet, rewards, and near-real-time features.

The role

You’ll work across our event-driven, serverless stack to maintain and evolve production systems. That means adding features, fixing bugs, improving performance and cost, tightening security, and raising reliability—while collaborating closely with Mobile/Web.

What you’ll do

  • Maintain and evolve AWS Lambda microservices behind Amazon API Gateway (HTTP/REST & WebSocket) and AWS IoT Core ; implement authentication/authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST/HTTP.
  • Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS); handle indexes, migrations, and query performance.
  • Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS/SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics/logs and alarms.
  • Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and environment promotions.
  • Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud/risk, analytics and support tooling.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks.
  • Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability).

Tech you’ll touch

AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST/WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation/SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech/comms integrations (Open Banking/PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools).

Must-haves

  • 8+ years building/maintaining production backends; 4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js; strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns.
  • Solid SQL/NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning).
  • Experience maintaining IaC (SAM/CloudFormation) and CI/CD (Code Pipeline).
  • Security-first mindset and practical debugging/troubleshooting chops (OWASP).
  • WebSocket/API Gateway connection management and real-time features.
  • Payments/fintech and fraud/risk integrations.
  • Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs.
  • Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines/warehousing exposure.

How we work

Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability.

Hiring process

  • Intro call
  • Technical deep-dive (systems design discussions focused on maintainability and evolution)
  • Practical walkthrough (IaC/API/data-modeling maintenance scenario)
  • Founder/lead chat & references

Equal opportunity

We’re an equal-opportunity employer and welcome every background and perspective.

How to apply

Send your CV, GitHub/portfolio, and a brief note describing a production backend you maintained/evolved and the reliability or cost improvements you delivered.

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .

title: Gerente de Projetos de Design
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera no modelo de fractional design team : o fundador atua como design lead embedded dentro de empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e marca. A Bas-Alto é a estrutura que sustenta essa atuação: um time de designers entregando produto, web e visual design em paralelo, com o Gerente de Projetos/DesignOps garantindo que tudo opere com consistência enquanto o fundador está focado na frente estratégica. Site para referência:


Estamos contratando um(a) Gerente de Projetos para trabalhar como \"braço direito operacional \" do fundador do estúdio na gestão de projetos de design. O papel central é garantir que o time de designers tenha sempre briefings claros, prioridades bem definidas e entregas organizadas, mantendo múltiplos projetos simultâneos rodando com qualidade e sem perder prazo.


Responsabilidades

  • Representar o fundador em múltiplos projetos ativos, sendo o ponto de contato entre clientes, equipe e partes interessadas
  • Traduzir necessidades e objetivos em projetos organizados, com escopo definido, prioridades claras e briefings executáveis para a equipe de design
  • Gerenciar tarefas, entregas e prazos em plataformas como ClickUp, Asana, Notion ou similares
  • Acompanhar o andamento de entregas de design (produto, web e marketing), garantindo qualidade e consistência
  • Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
  • Comunicar com clientes no dia a dia sobre atualizações de projeto, próximos passos e alinhamentos gerais, por escrito em inglês
  • Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
  • Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento


Necessário

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos, de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups
  • Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais
  • Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX.
  • Inglês fluente em escrita e leitura. Mais de 90% dos projetos e da comunicação do dia a dia são em inglês, incluindo termos técnicos
  • Extrema organização e atenção a detalhe para manejar múltiplas frentes ao mesmo tempo
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto com clientes quanto com a equipe
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
  • Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário: a negociar, a partir de R$ 3.600+, conforme experiência e senioridade
  • Contratação: CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho: 100% remoto
  • Horário flexível. Obs.: É necessária disponibilidade para atender demandas também no período noturno, devido ao fuso horário de clientes da Califórnia (4h antes do Brasil).

title: Consultor SAP FI – Suporte & Sustentação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

O profissional atuará com foco principal em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade, aderência às regras locais (Brasil e LATAM) e alinhamento com diretrizes globais. Também participará de projetos, melhorias e iniciativas de evolução do sistema, conforme demanda do negócio.


  • Contrato: Vaga temporária - Duração de 1 mês, ideal para profissionais disponíveis imediatamente, atuando com SAP FI!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Atuar prioritariamente na sustentação e suporte do SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade do ambiente e atendimento às demandas do negócio.
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes e requisições relacionadas aos processos financeiros.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Finanças e Controladoria na correta utilização do sistema.
  • Garantir aderência às regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Realizar análises funcionais detalhadas e propor soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas.
  • Configurar, testar e validar soluções no SAP FI.
  • Apoiar processos como: Fechamento contábil mensal (Month-End Close); Integrações financeiras; Especificidades fiscais brasileiras; Integrações com outros módulos SAP.
  • Identificar melhorias contínuas em processos e parametrizações.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e evidências de testes.
  • Participar de projetos de implementação, rollouts, melhorias e upgrades SAP.
  • Conduzir workshops para levantamento de requisitos quando necessário.
  • Validar e testar especificidades Brasil e LATAM durante atualizações do sistema.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de CSV para garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Assegurar qualidade e integridade dos dados financeiros no SAP.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente profissionais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Atuar como interface entre Brasil/LATAM e Headquarter para temas relacionados a SAP FI.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI.

VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Sales Manager - Water Treatment
description:
Atrio Search is partnered with a global leader in advanced water treatment technologies, delivering innovative solutions including Reverse Osmosis (RO) membranes, ultrafiltration systems, and ion exchange resins . Their products support a wide range of municipal, industrial, and commercial applications.


The company is seeking a candidate with 5+ years of experience in the industrial water treatment sector , with strong familiarity in RO systems, membrane filtration, or fluid separation technologies. An established network of OEMs, service providers, engineering firms, and consultants across Brazil is highly desirable.


In this role, you will manage and grow existing business while also generating new opportunities and revenue streams. A proactive hunter mindset is essential.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own and execute the regional go‑to‑market strategy.
  • Drive revenue growth by developing new partner relationships and managing the full commercial cycle.
  • Identify and progress opportunities to meet and exceed quarterly sales targets.
  • Lead contract negotiations and build long‑term relationships with partners and customers.

  • Work closely with Marketing, Technical Service, Engineering, and R&D to translate customer needs into technical solutions.
  • Provide actionable market insights to internal teams.
  • Collaborate with colleagues and contribute to a winning team culture


Requirements

  • 5–10 years of experience in sales, marketing, or business development within the industrial water treatment sector.
  • Deep understanding of RO systems, membrane filtration, or fluid separation technologies.
  • Strong client network and a proven sales track record in industries such as wastewater, mining, power, or refining.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and good English skills with excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Valid driver’s license and availability for 30–50% travel.


Education:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, chemistry, environmental science, or business with relevant technical experience.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Devops (foco em testes de Infraestrutura) para construir testes end-to-end abrangentes para nossa infraestrutura em AWS e fluxos de CI/CD. Principais responsabilidades

Experiências esperadas

Diferenciais

Ambiente Técnico

  • GitLab CI para deploys
  • Helm para configuração de Kubernetes

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: VFX- Subject Matter Expert
description:
VFX- Fully Remote Subject Matter Expert


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting 3D Artists and VFX experts with experience creating computer generated scenes and assets to join our global network for a high level gaming project.


Rather than traditional VFX work, we are offering an opportunity to licence existing ‘on-the-shelf’ works from your archives, plus hourly compensation for technical processing.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Asset licencing: Licence existing works from your personal/ studio archives for a flat fee
  • Technical processing including rendering, layering, and preparing these files to our data specifications
  • In some cases, making variations to scenes and re-rendering


Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching


What You’ll Bring

  • Experience as a 3D, Technical or VFX Artist or Compositor in games, film or digital production
  • Experience with Unreal Engine, Unity & Houdini, Maya / Blender / Cinema4D and similar
  • Expertise in rendering, lighting and texturing
  • Comfortable using technical workflows and tools
  • Existing assets for licensing, with scenes separated into coherent, compositable layers


Nice To Have

  • Experience in the Gaming industry
  • Elements including depth, albedo, shading, gloss, cryptomat
  • Complex occlusions, atmospherics and crowd dynamics


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.



Why join this project?

This is an opportunity to licence your existing assets and to apply your expertise in VFX design on a flexible, ad hoc basis, in order to help improve AI systems for video generation with better controllability for creators.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

  • Background in Math, Stats, Machine Learning

  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.

title: Pre-Sales Consultant - Physical AI - Brazil
description:
We are seeking a technically fluent Pre-Sales Consultant to join our Physical AI Solutions team. In this role you will serve as the connective tissue between prospective customers and our delivery organization, translating complex robotics and autonomous-systems requirements into compelling, commercially viable solution proposals. You will work across our three core service lines ADAS Data Collection & Labeling, Robotics Data Collection & Labeling, Computer Vision data solutions to shape deals that accelerate the development of ADAS systems, vision-language-action (VLA) models, and sim-to-real transfer pipelines.


Key Responsibilities


• Solution Design & Scoping: Partner with prospects to understand their robotics model-training pipelines (VLM pre-training, VLA fine-tuning, RL alignment) and design data collection & labeling solutions that map to each stage.

• Technical Discovery: Lead technical discovery sessions covering sensor modalities (LiDAR, radar, camera, IMU), annotation taxonomies (3D bounding boxes, semantic segmentation, 6-DoF pose), and simulation requirements (Isaac Sim, Real2Sim asset creation).

• Proposal Development: Author technical proposals, SOWs, and RFP/RFI responses that articulate data pipelines, quality frameworks, tooling (e.g., proprietary labeling platforms), and delivery timelines.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Delivery, and Product teams to validate feasibility, refine pricing models, and ensure smooth handoff from pre-sales to production.

• Market Intelligence: Stay current on robotics industry trends, foundation models, sim-to-real transfer, egocentric AI, 3D kinematics, reinforcement learning and feed insights back into go-to-market strategy.

• Customer Presentations & Demos: Develop and deliver tailored presentations, proof-of-concept demonstrations, and workshop sessions for technical and executive audiences.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role within data services, AI/ML, or robotics.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Strong understanding of autonomous driving and/or robotics data pipelines: sensor fusion, data collection at scale, annotation workflows, and quality assurance.

• Familiarity with machine learning model-training workflows, including data curation, labeling taxonomies, and evaluation metrics.

• Experience with at least two of: LiDAR point-cloud processing, camera/image annotation, 3D reconstruction, or simulation environments.

• Proven ability to translate complex technical requirements into clear proposals and commercial terms.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to both engineers and business teams.


Preferred Qualifications


• Direct experience with ADAS or L2–L5 autonomous driving programs at an OEM, Tier-1, or technology partner.

• Hands-on exposure to VLMs, VLAs, or sim-to-real transfer techniques.

• Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or equivalent robotics simulation platforms.

• Experience scoping egocentric data collection projects (AR/VR headsets, wearable sensors).

• Prior work at a Robotics, ADAS or AI training-data company.

• Master’s degree or higher in a relevant technical discipline.


What We Offer


• A front-row seat to the Physical AI revolution, working with leading robotics and autonomous vehicle companies worldwide.

• Competitive base salary.

• Comprehensive benefits package.

• Flexible remote-first culture.

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

  • Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app.

  • Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas.
  • Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código.


O que buscamos

Pessoas que:

  • Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção.
  • Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile.
  • Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos.
  • Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance.
  • Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean).
  • Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação.
  • Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante.
  • Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios.
  • Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção.
  • Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

description:
We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - (Vue / Node.js)
description:
This is a 100% Remote Independent Contractor Role.


About Equate Media

Equate Media is a growth-focused digital company that builds software and operational systems designed to improve efficiency, support customer engagement, and drive measurable business results. Our teams work closely across engineering, marketing, and operations to solve practical problems, improve workflows, and create systems that make a real impact. We value speed, ownership, adaptability, and people who enjoy building useful things in a fast-moving environment.


About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to help strengthen and expand a real-time communications platform used every day by the business. This person will step into an existing production environment, work through active issues, improve platform reliability, and help push new functionality into production quickly.


The work touches both frontend and backend systems tied to inbound and outbound call activity, routing logic, internal buffering, operational tooling, and live user workflows. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving real production problems, working across the stack, and making meaningful contributions without a lot of hand-holding.


Where you’ll make an impact

  • Get up to speed quickly in an existing multi-service production platform
  • Investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and third-party integrations
  • Deliver new features at a high pace while keeping stability and maintainability in mind
  • Improve systems that support real-time call flows, routing behavior, and internal buffering
  • Build and refine interfaces used for live operations and communication workflows
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and platform functionality tied directly to business performance
  • Help improve visibility, reliability, and overall behavior in a live production environment
  • Contribute to engineering decisions and help raise execution standards across the team


Tools and environment

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router
  • Backend: Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express
  • Real-time / Communications: Socket.IO, WebRTC, browser based calling with Twilio/Sinch/similar system
  • Infrastructure / Services: AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ / AMQP, PM2
  • Monitoring / Error Tracking: Sentry


What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack software developer
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js
  • Strong frontend experience with Vue, or strong experience with a modern frontend framework and the ability to work confidently in a Vue codebase
  • Experience working in existing production systems, not only creating from scratch
  • Ability to troubleshoot across the stack and solve real-world issues efficiently
  • Experience shipping features quickly in fast-moving environments
  • Strong instincts around performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Comfortable taking ownership and operating independently
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud-based production environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams


Bonus Points For

  • Telephony, VoIP, call routing, or communications platforms
  • Twilio, Sinch, or similar providers
  • Real-time systems, event-driven architecture, queues, or worker-based services
  • Redis, RabbitMQ, or live operational workflows
  • Improving legacy systems while continuing to ship new functionality
  • Exposure to AI-assisted workflows such as transcription, summarization, or automation


Why this role stands out

This is an opportunity to work on a live platform that supports real operational activity and directly impacts the business. You’ll be solving practical problems, improving systems that people rely on every day, and helping shape what gets built next. If you enjoy working in production systems, fixing meaningful problems, and shipping useful features quickly, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 13k-18k BRL/mo.


Must-Haves:

  • 2-5 years of experience in a data engineering/ analyst role
  • Experience with Python (ETL, transformations)
  • PySpark specifically (via Databricks)
  • Familiarity with pandas‑style transformations
  • Experience with SQL for database querying and management
  • Experience with Tableau
  • Strong visual storytelling
  • Ability to innovate and make dashboards genuinely usable


Nice-To-Haves:

  • Experience working with Databricks

Day to day:

A client of Insight Global is looking to hire a data analyst to join their team remotely in the LATAM region. This person will be responsible for partnering directly with business stakeholders to define KPIs, gather requirements, and deliver end to end data solutions. This person's main focus will be on enabling the business through clean data, strong analytics, and exceptional visualization. This person will not be maintaining existing pipelines, but building new ones to support the client's strategic initiatives.

Key responsibilities listed below:

  • Partner 1:1 with business stakeholders to:
  • Understand goals and initiatives
  • Define KPIs and success metrics
  • Perform end‑to‑end data work:
  • Identify and validate data sources
  • Transform data to align with business goals
  • Build net‑new ETL pipelines as needed
  • Develop dashboards and reporting in Tableau that:
  • Tell a clear story
  • Are visually polished and intuitive
  • Are suitable for senior leadership consumption
  • Create presentations and insights that support executive decision‑making
  • Operate in a project‑based environment with ownership from intake to delivery

title: Sustainability Specialist
description:
Junior Sustainability Specialist

Location : Remote (Brazil)

Contract : 6 months - 40 hours/wk

Rate : $4-6/hr USD - BRL $4,330-5,200 / month


Job Description

Insight Global is looking for an entry‑level Sustainability Analyst / Sustainability Specialist to join our client's growing sustainability function. This role will support a small, highly collaborative sustainability team of two and will play a hands‑on role in sustainability reporting, environmental impact analysis, and data‑driven research initiatives.


This is an excellent opportunity for a new graduate with relevant academic or project experience, or an early‑career professional (1–3 years of experience) looking to grow their career in corporate sustainability within a global SaaS organization. The role is fully remote within Brazil and requires strong English communication skills due to close collaboration with international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support sustainability reporting initiatives, including data collection, validation, and preparation of internal and external sustainability disclosures.
  • Perform Excel‑based data analysis related to environmental and sustainability metrics, including working with large datasets to identify trends and insights.
  • Assist with environmental impact reporting, including drafting written content and supporting documentation for sustainability reports and customer‑facing materials.
  • Conduct customer and market research related to sustainability programs, expectations, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with the sustainability team and cross‑functional partners to support ongoing sustainability initiatives and operational priorities.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Environmental Studies, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience supporting sustainability or ESG reporting through academic projects, internships, or professional roles.
  • Strong Excel skills, including data analysis using pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic data validation techniques.
  • Experience conducting structured research and synthesizing findings into clear written outputs.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a global, remote environment.


Nice to Have

  • Exposure to carbon accounting, greenhouse gas (GHG) inventories, or climate‑related data analysis.
  • Familiarity with sustainability or ESG frameworks (e.g., GRI, SASB, TCFD, CDP) through coursework or practical experience.
  • Experience working in a SaaS, technology, or professional services environment.
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where priorities may evolve quickly.


We may use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the screening, assessment, or selection of potential applicants for this position.

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Senior Paid Media Specialist

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $8000 USD per month


Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: Scrum Master - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Node.Js Pleno
description:

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.
