title: Executivo de território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!
Responsabilidades:
Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;
Requisitos e qualificações
Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
Carteira de motorista B;
Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)
Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand: A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia; A Legrand hoje:
Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano; História recente:
Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Descrição da Empresa Plataforma de carreira da nova economia com mais 10 mil alunos formados. Somos uma empresa de educação que oferece cursos, pós graduação e mestrados internacionais. Missão: Gerar oportunidades de crescimento e mudança de vida para profissionais da área que buscam sucesso e satisfação pessoal e financeira.
Visão: Ser a empresa referência no setor de educação para saúde e impactar mais de 100.000 vidas e 5.000 profissionais
Valores: Clientes no centro, verdade, ambição e sentimento de melhorias. Aqui no grupo Unilife acreditamos que o verdadeiro sucesso vem de uma equipe engajada e inspirada. Nossa cultura reflete nosso compromisso em criar um ambiente de trabalho que não apenas apoie o crescimento e o desenvolvimento profissional, mas também valorize cada membro da equipe, acreditamos que cada colaborador tem papel essencial na concretização da visão de impacto social da empresa. Aqui nossos colaboradores tem possibilidade e visão de crescimento no nosso ecossistema.
Estamos contratando Consultor de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe em Salvador, BA. As principais responsabilidades incluem atender clientes, buscar clientes, identificar suas necessidades e recomendar soluções educacionais alinhadas às suas metas. Você também será responsável por acompanhar negociações, esclarecer dúvidas e garantir um alto nível de satisfação do cliente. Este é um cargo presencial e em regime de contratação.
Qualificações
Consultoria de Vendas: Experiência em consultoria de vendas, conhecimento em estratégias de vendas e habilidade para identificar oportunidades no mercado. Relacionamento com o Cliente: Competência em manter a satisfação do cliente e oferecer um serviço de alta qualidade que corresponda ou supere as expectativas. Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação clara e eficaz para interações cliente e equipe, auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas e esclarecimento de informações. Experiência em consultoria e atendimento ao cliente será um diferencial, assim como familiaridade com o setor educacional e ferramentas de CRM.
Informações Indispensáveis: Modalidade PJ de trabalho Modelo de trabalho híbrido: Segunda a sexta presencial e sábado home office.
O que é importante para o perfil: Desejo de crescer na sua carreira Desejo de sempre aprender novas habilidades Desejo de sempre melhorar suas técnicas Sempre está se capacitando sobre o tema vendas Desenvolve Skills de comunicação, relação interpessoal e inteligência emocional
Experiência: Mínimo de 30 vendas no período de 90 dias.
Remuneração Salário + Ajuda de custo + Comissão + bonificações
FIXO Júnior (até R$150.000) R$1.700 Pleno (R$151k–R$250k) R$2.200 Sênior (R$251k–R$300k) R$2.850 Expert (R$301k–R$320k) R$3.400
Ajuda de custo R$595
Comissões e bonificações são informados no processo seletivo

description:
Responsável por executar atividades de controle, organização e movimentação de materiais, assegurando a acuracidade do estoque e o atendimento eficiente às demandas internas. Atua na recepção, armazenagem e distribuição de itens, mantendo o ambiente organizado e garantindo o fluxo adequado de suprimentos.
Ensino médio completo

title: Customs specialist
description:
Responsibilities:
Responsible for accurately reviewing customs codes,proficiently applying trade preferential policies and relevant tax rules, conducting tariff analysis and commodity classification audits on imported and exported goods, and adopting legal and compliant tariff preferential tax rules;
Coordinate the system requirements docking of the customs information module,implement the construction and functional improvement of the customs clearance
system;
Served as a consultant for customs system, responsible for daily business system operation cooperation, online and daily exception handling, processing trade compliance self
inspection,management,etc:
Responsible for communicating with local customs and
handling abnormal issues.
Qualifications:
College degree or above,
Able to work overseas for 3 year or more,
Strong proficiency in English/Chinese for Portuguese Native Speakers (listening,speaking, reading, and writing). Or strong proficiency in Portuguese for Chinese Native Speakers:
Master professional knowledge of customs business, be familiar with customs clearance process essentials and customs policies and regulations; Familiar with customs inspection expertise,trade security knowledge, customs related laws and regulations, etc.. with certain ability to identify customs declaration risks:
Familiar with product classification and have participated in the construction of customs clearance systems;
Having clear logical thinking, good communication and teamwork skills, and the ability to flexibly respond and solve problems;
Experience in supporting overseas logistics or customs related work, with overseas permanent residency experience preferred.

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Descrição da Empresa Sugerimos que insira os detalhes aqui.Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Assistente Administrativo para se juntar ao time D MAIS EDUCAÇÃO em Salvador, BA. As responsabilidades do cargo incluem o suporte administrativo geral, atendimento telefônico com postura e educação, organização de documentos e realização de tarefas rotineiras de escritório. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença nas dependências da empresa.Qualificações
Assistência Administrativa: Habilidade em prestar suporte administrativo e gerenciar tarefas comuns de escritório de forma organizada e eficiente.
Etiqueta Telefônica: Experiência em atendimento telefônico com eficácia e cordialidade, garantindo boa comunicação com os diversos públicos da empresa.
Comunicação: Capacidade clara e adequada para comunicar-se de forma verbal e escrita, essencial para interagir com diferentes equipes e partes interessadas.
Gestão Administrativa e Clerical: Conhecimentos em tarefas administrativas de suporte executivo e habilidades clericais, como organização de documentos e controle de agendas.
Experiência prévia comprovada na área administrativa e domínio do pacote Microsoft Office serão considerados diferenciais significativos.

title: Game presenters (relocation to armenia)
description:
Pentasia is actively looking for Game Presenters (Relocation to Armenia)!
The Company: Our client is currently seeking enthusiastic, motivated, and dynamic individuals to join their team as Game Hosts/Presenters in the Sales and Business Development department, on-site in Armenia. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing and facilitating various games while maintaining a high level of professionalism and ensuring exceptional customer service.
If you enjoy engaging with people and thrive in a camera-friendly environment, then this exciting opportunity is tailor-made for you!
Responsibilities:
Conduct games in accordance with established procedures, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience for participants (don't worry, you will receive complete training for the role!)
Engage with players through verbal interaction in the game chat, providing guidance and support as needed.
Demonstrate honesty and accuracy in all aspects of game presentation.
Attend mandatory meetings and training sessions as required.
Adhere to designated work schedules and dress code standards.
Always uphold the highest professional standards.
Required Qualifications: Fluent in spoken and written Portuguese and English. Strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail.
Presentable appearance and grooming.
Passion for delivering exceptional customer service.
Willingness to work flexible hours, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays.
Benefits and offer:
Salary NET $1,000 + incentives.
Relocation with Visa assistance.
Performance-based bonuses.
Company accommodation.
Medical insurance coverage.
Access to free language courses.
Teambuilding activities and corporate events.
Complimentary tea, coffee, and refreshments.
Flexible working schedule.
Free parking facilities.
Privilege card for additional perks.
Corporate gym access.

title: Coordenador(a) de dho
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:
Coordenar de forma integrada as frentes de Recrutamento e Seleção, Treinamento e Desenvolvimento, Cultura e Clima Organizacional nas unidades da BPN, garantindo a execução padronizada das práticas de DHO em alinhamento com as diretrizes estratégicas da companhia.
Garantir o planejamento e execução dos programas de desenvolvimento técnico, comportamental e de liderança.
Coordenar a condução dos processos seletivos e assegurar o alinhamento dos perfis contratados à cultura da empresa.
Coordenar o desdobramento e a execução dos projetos estratégicos de sucessão, cultura organizacional, employer branding e engajamento, assegurando a adaptação às necessidades locais e o alinhamento com as diretrizes corporativas.
Coordenar o processo de avaliação de desempenho, garantindo sua aplicação conforme os ciclos definidos, apoiando as lideranças na análise dos resultados e no planejamento de ações de desenvolvimento individual e organizacional.
Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento da área, controlando investimentos em treinamento e seleção.
Acompanhar e analisar os indicadores de desempenho da área de DHO, propondo planos de ação para melhoria contínua.
Garantir a execução e padronização dos processos conforme as diretrizes corporativas de RH.
Atuar como parceiro das lideranças na construção e execução de soluções de desenvolvimento humano.
Representar a área de DHO em auditorias, reuniões corporativas e projetos transversais da companhia.
Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.
Requisitos:
Ensino superior completo em Psicologia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
Desejável pós-graduação em Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas afins.
Experiência com gestão de pessoas.
Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA.
Domínio em gestão de processos de R&S, T&D, clima e cultura, em planejamento e execução de programas de desenvolvimento e sucessão.
Domínio em gestão de indicadores de DHO, orçamento da área, Sistemas de RH e em LMS (Sistema de Gestão de Aprendizagem)
Vivência com pacote office, principalmente Excel.
Vivência com ferramentas de avaliação e diagnóstico organizacional.
Desejável Inglês.
Aviso Legal: Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.
Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.
Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Pessoa diretora de unidade - feira de santana
description:
Nós somos a Cogna, a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país.
Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos.
Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional.
Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si.
Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!

Responsabilidades e atribuições: - Gerenciar a equipe da unidade, garantindo a efetividade dos processos e a qualidade dos serviços prestados
- Planejar e executar estratégias para o alcance dos objetivos da unidade, visando o crescimento e a rentabilidade
- Gerenciar os recursos financeiros da unidade, elaborando e acompanhando o orçamento
- Gerenciar projetos e processos, buscando a melhoria contínua e a eficiência operacional
- Negociar com fornecedores e parceiros, visando a obtenção de melhores condições comerciais
- Gerenciar contratos e acordos com clientes e fornecedores, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações
- Garantir a qualidade dos serviços prestados pela unidade, implementando e monitorando processos e indicadores
- Gerenciar os riscos da unidade, identificando e mitigando potenciais problemas

Requisitos e qualificações: - Graduação em Administração
- Pós-Graduação em Gestão de Negócios
- MBA em Gestão Empresarial
- Cursos de Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas
- Conhecimento em Lean Six Sigma
- Experiência comprovada em gestão de pessoas, liderança, gestão financeira, planejamento estratégico, gestão de projetos, gestão de processos, negociação, gestão de contratos, gestão de qualidade e gestão de riscos
- Habilidade em comunicação, trabalho em equipe, resiliência, flexibilidade e proatividade

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!
Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.
Seguro de Vida: Este beneficio é compulsório, a todos os colaboradores CLT, sem custo, e estão inclusos na apólice de seguro, a partir da sua data de admissão.
Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.
Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Coordenador de obras - incorporação
description:
Oportunidade: Coordenador de Obras (Incorporação) Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Obras com perfil dinâmico e visão estratégica para integrar nosso time de Engenharia. Este profissional será o elo entre o planejamento da incorporadora e a execução técnica no canteiro, garantindo que nossos empreendimentos sejam entregues com excelência, dentro do prazo e do orçamento. Requisitos Fundamentais (Obrigatórios)
Experiência Comprovada: Vivência sólida na coordenação de múltiplas obras simultâneas no segmento de incorporação imobiliária (residencial ou comercial).
Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil com registro ativo no CREA.
Visão de Incorporação: Entendimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto imobiliário (do projeto à entrega das chaves/assistência técnica).
Responsabilidades e Atribuições Gestão Multiobras: Coordenar simultaneamente o andamento de diferentes canteiros, garantindo a padronização de processos e qualidade. Interface Estratégica: Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas de Projetos, Suprimentos e Financeiro da Incorporadora. Controle de Cronograma: Monitorar o caminho crítico das obras, antecipar riscos e propor planos de ação para desvios de prazo. Gestão de Custos: Acompanhar o fluxo de caixa das obras e o cumprimento do orçamento previsto (VGV/Custos diretos). Liderança de Equipes: Orientar os engenheiros residentes e equipes técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e segurança. Qualidade e Normas: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, PBQP-H e legislações municipais vigentes. Pré-requisitos Adicionais e Diferenciais Softwares de Gestão: Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento (MS Project ou Primavera) e ERPs de engenharia (Ex: Sienge , UAU ou Totvs). Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Lean Construction (Construção Enxuta) para otimização de processos. title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Alteryx server specialist - latam based
description:
Position Summary
Data Meaning is a front-runner in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics consulting, renowned for our high-quality consulting services throughout the US and LATAM. Our expertise lies in delivering tailored solutions in Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and Project Management. We are dedicated to bringing premier services to our diverse clientele. We have a global team of 95+ consultants, all working remotely, embodying a collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven work culture.Position Overview
We are proactively building a pipeline of experienced Alteryx Specialists who are passionate about data analytics and business intelligence. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects, leveraging your expertise in Alteryx to drive data-driven decision-making across the organization.Responsibilities:
Utilize Alteryx as the primary tool to design, develop, and implement data analytics workflows, ETL processes, and data integration solutions.
Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into actionable insights using Alteryx.
Apply additional skills, such as Power BI or other relevant tools, to enhance data visualization and reporting capabilities for client projects.
Communicate with clients in a professional and client-facing manner, ensuring clear understanding of requirements, project updates, and deliverables.
Perform data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation tasks using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
Develop and maintain documentation for Alteryx workflows, including workflow diagrams, data dictionaries, and user guides.
Conduct data quality assessments and implement data validation processes to ensure accuracy and integrity of the outputs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate Alteryx outputs with Tableau, Power BI, or other reporting tools.
Stay updated with the latest industry trends and advancements in Alteryx and related technologies to continuously enhance technical skills and provide innovative solutions to clients.
Provide technical support and assistance to clients during the implementation and deployment of Alteryx workflows.Qualifications:
Strong proficiency in Alteryx Designer, with a deep understanding of Alteryx workflows, formulas, macros, and data integration processes.
Proficiency with Alteryx Server
Additional skills in Power BI or other data visualization tools are highly preferred.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact with clients in a professional and client-facing manner.
Fluency in Spanish is a huge plus, enabling effective communication with clients in the LATAM market.
Experience in data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
Knowledge of ETL processes and data integration techniques.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with great attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

title: Gerente suínocultura
description:
Garantir a produção eficiente, sustentável e de alta qualidade nas granjas (creches e engorda), por meio da gestão estratégica de pessoas, processos e recursos, assegurando o bem-estar animal, a sanidade do plantel e rentabilidade do negócio, em conformidade com as normas técnicas ambientais e de biossegurança. Dominar o manejo reprodutivo (cobertura, inseminação, diagnóstico de gestação), de crescimento, engorda e nutrição animal, sanidade e medicamentos.
Principais Responsabilidades Planejar e garantir a execução de todas as etapas: reprodução (cobertura, inseminação artificial, diagnóstico de gestação), controle de ciclo estral, taxas de fertilidade, parto e desmame, gestão de matrizes e leitões. Maternidade , creche e terminação (manejo nutricional por fase, conversão alimentar e ganho de peso, estratégias para redução de perdas, planejamento de abate). Monitorizar indicadores zootécnicos (taxa de parto, mortalidade, ganho de peso, conversão alimentar).
Garantir cumprimento das metas de produção e qualidade.
Implementar e garantir protocolos sanitários e de vacinação.
Controlar uso correto de medicamentos veterinários.
Prevenir surtos e agir rapidamente em casos de doença.
Assegurar cumprimentos de normas de biossegurança.
Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe operacional.
Distribuir atividades e garantir disciplina operacional.
Acompanhar desempenho e engajamento.
Construir cultura de responsabilidade e cuidado.
Controlar custos (ração, medicamentos, mão de obra e insumos).
Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios.
Garantir rentabilidade da operação.
Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores.
Preparar granjas para auditorias e certificações.
Garantir bem-estar animal.
Atuar junto com fornecedores.

title: Advogado associado
description:
Rodrigo Galvão Sociedade Individual de Advocacia está em busca de um(a) Advogado(a) Associado(a) para integrar sua equipe jurídica e atuar de forma híbrida, em regime integral.
Sobre o Escritório: Rodrigo Galvão Sociedade Individual de Advocacia é um escritório dedicado a oferecer soluções jurídicas estratégicas e personalizadas, com atuação pautada pela ética, excelência técnica e compromisso com resultados.
Nosso trabalho é orientado pela construção de relações de confiança com os clientes, buscando sempre soluções jurídicas eficientes e inovadoras. description:
Apply here:
About the role
We are looking for a sharp, execution-oriented strategy professional to work directly with C-suite clients across multiple industries. You will own workstreams end-to-end, from problem structuring and hypothesis development to stakeholder alignment and final delivery.
This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role designed for professionals who thrive in fast-paced, intellectually demanding environments and who are used to that standard from tier-1 consulting firms.
Who we're looking for:
Professionals with a background in top-tier global strategy or management consulting firms (Mc Kinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, KPMG, Pw C, EY, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, or equivalent). The rigor, structure, and pace expected here mirrors what you already know.
What you will do:
Lead hypothesis-driven diagnostic and strategy engagements for clients across sectors
Own workstream delivery: structuring the problem, building the analytical framework, and presenting findings to senior leadership
Drive C-suite and board-level stakeholder management with executive communication and influence
Translate complex data and qualitative insights into clear, actionable strategic recommendations
Support business development conversations and contribute to proposal writing when relevant
Collaborate asynchronously with cross-functional, globally distributed teams Apply here:
What we expect
3-8 years of experience in a top-tier strategy or management consulting firm (MBB, Big4 Strategy, or equivalent tier-1 firm)
Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems and drive engagement delivery from kickoff to final output
Strong financial modeling and data analysis skills
Experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting to C-level executives
Ability to operate with high autonomy in a fully remote, async-first environment
Advanced English Apply here:
This is an external position to work at a Wise VAs client. Similarly, candidates acknowledge and authorize the storage of resumes and proposals in Wise VAs's database, as well as the receipt of messages, emails, and calls offering new job positions and opportunities.

title: Meitu campus ambassador (analytics track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship
We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.
● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.
We're looking for someone who is:
● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.
● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.
● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.
Bonus if you have:
● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).
● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.
What You'll Get
Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team
● Early access to product features and training sessions
● Workshops on social media, product, or design
Rewards & Credit System
We'll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!
Redeem credits for:
● Annual Meitu products membership
● " Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador" Certificate + internship reference
● Meitu Special Deisgn
● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership
● Summer Internship Offer
● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)
About Meitu
Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.
Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357. HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Technical implementation specialist
description:
Why Kodif?
At Kodif, we're transforming how customers interact with e Commerce brands. From shopping to support to retention, we're building agentic AI systems that make every website interaction personalized, instant, and human-like — redefining the modern customer journey.
Highlights:
Our team comes from Uber, Meta, Stanford, and Walmart. Our CTO built Uber's customer support platform.
We're backed by Bling Capital, SNR (Kevin Mahaffey), and Village Global (backed by Jeff Bezos, Bill Gates, and Reid Hoffman), with $9 M raised to date.
We're trusted by leading e Commerce brands like Dollar Shave Club, Liquid I. V., Trust Wallet, and Alma. Our Culture & Values:
At Kodif, our values guide how we work, what we build, and how we grow together:
Make It Simple – Build systems that are clear, reliable, and scalable.
Superhuman Speed ️ – Move fast and own the outcome — design, build, and deploy in days, not weeks.
Extreme Ownership – Take end-to-end responsibility for delivering impact, not just features.
Customer Crazy – We obsess over creating delightful, human-like AI experiences for our customers.
Two Steps Ahead – Anticipate issues before they surface. Design for the future.
Row Together – Collaborate, communicate, and ship together — success at Kodif is a team sport. Position Overview:
The Technical Implementation Specialist focuses on implementation of AI automation workflows, technical troubleshooting, product behavior analysis, and technical issue resolution. This role combines proactive customer management with technical troubleshooting, enabling Kodif's customers to maximize the value of our platform.
The Implementation Specialist will work cross-functionally to resolve issues, identify risks, and help customers succeed with the Kodif platform.
Responsibilities:
Partner with customers to align product adoption strategies with business goals.
Monitor customer communication channels to identify issues, resolve them, and escalate to Tier 2 technical support when needed.
Identify and mitigate risks related to usage, adoption, or critical defects by creating and executing targeted action plans.
Initiate and manage escalation processes, coordinating communication between customers and internal teams.
Support post-mortem analyses for escalations or major incidents.
Relay customer feedback to product and engineering to influence roadmap priorities.
Address concerns early to reduce churn risk and support long-term retention.
Support internal teams with technical insights and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting guides, and product improvements. Requirements:
Experience in Support, Implementation, or Customer Success (preferably in AI or CX Saa S).
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills (no coding required).
Strong technical acumen and ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of building trust and advocating for customers.
Experience with ticketing systems, Slack-based support, or similar communication tools.
Experience with LLM prompting.
Ability to read and interpret JSON (e.g., identify failed integration calls and relevant fields). Nice to have:
Ability to interpret SQL-level data and database-driven summaries (light query writing may be required).
Ability to read Python-related error messages and escalate appropriately (no direct coding required). Compensation & Benefits:
Competitive salary based on location and work experience.
Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, product, and customer experience with real business impact.
Opportunity to build one of the most impactful AI systems in e Commerce. To be considered, please complete this short application form (2–3 minutes): YYr6 UDG4m RB9 SMt9 and then apply here as well.

DESENVOLVEDOR FULLSTACK SÊNIOR

Wellhub;
Seguro de vida;
Day off.

title: Senior electrical bim engineer
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U. S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.
We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:
Eracore is growing in Brazil, and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U. S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.
Why You'll Enjoy Working at Eracore
Competitive hourly pay
Continuing Education
Sports & Fitness
Fully remote work
Healthy work–life balance
Learning platforms for professional growth
Supportive leadership and mentorship Your Role
Perform hands-on VDC and Electrical BIM production, including modeling, coordination, shop drawings, and prefabrication deliverables.
Ensure all work complies with design intent, NEC codes, and client requirements.
Take full ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables with minimal supervision.
Identify and resolve clashes and coordination issues and support the development of coordination-ready drawings.
Manage tasks, project schedules, and internal deadlines effectively.
Participate in client coordination meetings to align design intent, standards, and technical requirements.
Support RFIs and technical clarifications as required.
Provide technical guidance, coaching, and oversight to junior and mid-level engineers.
Maintain strong proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, Evolve, and other required VDC tools. What We're Looking For
4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
Strong understanding of electrical systems
Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
Team-oriented mindset with mentoring experience
Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused
Spoken and technical written Intermediate English

title: Analista de requisitos
description:
Diariamente esse profissional vai:
Levantamento e especificação de requisitos de sistema;
Desenvolver e comunicar explicitamente a Meta do Produto; Criar, juntamente com os demais integrantes do Time, as Metas das Sprints;
Análise de problemas e proposição de soluções;
Serviço técnico de modelagem de processos de negócio e especificação de requisitos de sistemas de informação;
Definição de escopo, modelagem de dados, desenvolvimento de projeto lógico e elaboração de protótipo;
Elaboração de documentos de histórias de usuários, registro de acompanhamento do projeto;
Realizar a gestão eficaz do Backlog do Produto;
Participar de todas as Reuniões de Planejamento, Revisão e Retrospectiva da Sprint; Participar da Reunião Diária, quando solicitado, Esclarecer dúvidas do time sobre as regras de negócio;
Contribuir no desenho de soluções inovadoras e de valor para o cliente;
Monitorar a aplicação de processos de trabalho e melhores práticas pelas equipes de desenvolvimento, assegurando a execução do plano de trabalho firmado com o cliente;
Identificação de riscos para acompanhamento durante todo o ciclo de vida da execução dos serviços;
Elaboração, construção e manutenção de manuais Se ligue que você precisa de:
Ensino Superior completo em TI;
Sólida experiência ferramentas de desenvolvimento e gestão de projetos;
Certificação SFC (Scrum Fundaments Certified)
Experiencia mínima de 3 anos; Mas vai ser ótimo :
Se você conhecer metodologias ágeis. Utilização de banco de dados Microsoft SQL Server, My SQL, Postgre SQL em ambiente cliente/servidor ou web;
Se você ter as certificação reconhecida em Product Owner (PSPO ou CSPO), Certificação em Kanban (TKP ou KMP).

title: Ps project coordinator
description:
This position is Remote from Brazil only.
If it interests you please share your CV, and Availability to speak with me in PST time zone #
Rate $22.5/hr
6 months+ Extension
Fluent (speak, read, and write) in both Spanish and English. Portuguese is a plus.
MUST HAVE:
Experience with Google's G Suite (Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides).
Determine customer and *** project contacts from the Statement of Work.
Identify resources needed and assign or request the resource assignment to the engagement.
In conjunction with project stakeholders, establish project kickoff call and project start dates.
Develop a project schedule using appropriate tools and techniques and revise it to meet changing needs.
Ensure that all team members (internal and customer) understand the project's scope and what they are individually responsible for.
Maintain schedules of what tasks must be completed by what date, as well as team meetings. Coordinate and communicate schedule information to the project team.
Create and execute project work schedules and revise them as appropriate to meet changing needs.
Ensure project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately.
Track and report team hours and expenses on a weekly basis.
Create and provide weekly customer status reports throughout the engagement until the purchased Time & Expense is exhausted or Firm Fixed Priced deliverables are completed.
Good communication skills, including written, verbal, presentation, and adaptive (multi-level).
Good organizational skills, including tool utilization (spreadsheets, project management tools, mind maps), information capture, attention to detail, and prioritization.
Flexible to shifting priorities, demands, and timelines; able to promptly and efficiently react to project adjustments and alterations.

title: Closer comercial
description:
Vaga: Consultor(a) Comercial – Programa Flowgrammers
A Flowgrammers, iniciativa que faz parte do ecossistema da Ecosistema ED Soluções, está em busca de pessoas com mentalidade de crescimento, que queiram evoluir profissionalmente e fazer parte de um projeto que está em forte expansão.
Nosso propósito vai além de apenas vender. Trabalhamos com formação de pessoas, desenvolvimento comercial e liderança, criando um ambiente onde cada profissional tem a oportunidade de aprender, crescer e avançar para novos níveis dentro da organização.
Buscamos alguém com coração ensinável, que tenha sede de desenvolvimento, disciplina para executar e ambição de construir uma carreira sólida dentro de um time que valoriza cultura organizacional de alta performance.
Principais responsabilidades
• Prospecção de novos clientes e oportunidades de negócio
• Qualificação de leads e condução de reuniões comerciais
• Apresentação da solução e condução do processo de venda
• Desenvolvimento contínuo dentro do nosso método comercial
• Contribuir para o crescimento do time e do projeto
O que oferecemos
• Mentoria e desenvolvimento profissional focados em vendas, liderança e crescimento pessoal
• Participação em um projeto inovador e em forte crescimento
• Valor mínimo garantido para suporte inicial
• Comissões agressivas e possibilidade real de ganhos crescentes semanais
• Ambiente com cultura de alta performance e evolução constante
• Possibilidade de crescimento e absorção em novas oportunidades dentro do ecossistema ED Soluções
Perfil que buscamos
• Pessoas com mentalidade de crescimento
• Perfil comunicativo e orientado a resultados
• Vontade real de aprender, evoluir e crescer profissionalmente
• Espírito de equipe e comprometimento com metas
• Interesse em desenvolver carreira na área comercial
Essa é uma oportunidade para quem quer sair do lugar comum e construir uma trajetória de crescimento real dentro de um ecossistema que forma pessoas e desenvolve líderes.
Se você sente que está pronto para avançar para o próximo nível, candidate-se.

title: Game animator – igaming
description:
Game Animator | Rapid Play Games Remoto | PJ | Full-time Produto global | Slots & Casino
Na Rapid Play Games, nossos jogos não apenas funcionam — eles encantam. Cada spin, cada transição, cada efeito conta uma história. E quem dá vida a isso é a animação.
Estamos buscando um(a) Game Animator com energia positiva, olho clínico para movimento e paixão por criar experiências visuais que prendem o jogador na tela.
Se você vê uma animação de slot e já pensa em timing, easing, impacto visual e como fazer o jogador sentir aquele \"quase lá\", essa vaga é para você.
Seu papel aqui
Você será responsável por dar vida aos nossos jogos de cassino — dos símbolos ao feedback de vitória, das transições de tela aos efeitos especiais que fazem o jogador querer mais um spin.
No dia a dia, isso significa:
Criar animações 2 D para símbolos, personagens, UI e efeitos dentro dos jogos
Desenvolver motion design para transições, telas de bônus e celebrações de prêmio
Colaborar com game designers, artistas e devs para garantir que a animação reforce a experiência do jogador
Manter consistência visual e fluidez em diferentes jogos e plataformas
Otimizar animações para performance em web e mobile
Propor soluções criativas que elevem o impacto visual sem comprometer a entrega Você terá liberdade criativa real dentro de um time que valoriza quem traz ideias.

Experiência com animação 2 D (Spine, After Effects, ou ferramentas equivalentes)
Conhecimento sólido de motion design (timing, easing, peso, antecipação)
Ter trabalhado com jogos — entender o contexto interativo, não só o linear
Portfólio que demonstre qualidade de movimento e atenção a detalhes
Perfil positivo, colaborativo e orientado a solução
Boa comunicação (PT + EN) Diferenciais fortes
Experiência específica em i Gaming (slots/casino)
Conhecimento em animação 3 D (Blender, Cinema 4 D ou similar)

Interesse prático em IA aplicada a arte ou animação
Noção de UX e como a animação influencia o comportamento do jogador O que você encontra aqui
Autonomia real (sem microgerenciamento)
Ambiente rápido e direto
Produto internacional jogado no mundo todo
Cultura de aprendizado contínuo

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Performance marketing specialist
description:

Total compensation up to 60,000 EUR
Regular salary reviews and potential stock in future
Flexible contract models (B2 B or permanent)
Elite 100% remote team with backgrounds from Tier-1 tech companies
One of the fastest-scaling AI companies globally, with massive real-world adoption

As the company scales rapidly, your career will scale with it

title: Senior salesforce developer/release manager
description:
We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer/Release Manager to join our Salesforce Development Team on high-impact contracting engagement. As a Senior Salesforce Developer/Release Manager at Plative, you will be working with our internal team members to design, configure, implement, and deploy solutions from complex business requirements. You will be stepping into a critical and unique role, where you will dedicate your time to Salesforce development and integration task as well as managing releases.Our ideal candidate is a creative problem-solver, willing to take on any challenge, with the ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly. This is a high-visibility, client-facing role requiring a excellent communication, expert technical skills, and the ability to manage complex and high-demand projects.Responsibilities Include:
Release Management (50%): Own the end-to-end release process for a massive, multi-stream project. You will manage deployments, version control, and environment syncing to ensure stable delivery.
Full-Stack Salesforce Development: Design, develop, and support new applications on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Visualforce to extend functionality and meet complex business needs.
Advanced Integration Engineering: Utilize deep technical knowledge of Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, JSON) to build sophisticated point-to-point integrations and processes with external tools, applications, and databases.
UI/UX Development: Leverage web technologies including HTML, Java Script, and CSS to build intuitive and high-performing user interfaces.
Technical Advisory & Client Relations: Act as a primary technical contact for demanding stakeholders. You will participate in calls to gather requirements, debug high-priority issues, and translate complex technical topics for non-technical audiences.
Problem Solving & Incident Management: Independently analyze application problems and system incidents, developing rapid recommendations and robust solutions for an \"always-on\" project environment.
Agile Collaboration: Work within an agile-like methodology—managing user stories, participating in requirements gathering, and performing demos for internal and external teams.
Quality Assurance & Mentorship: Collaborate with internal and outsourced developers to delegate work, provide code expertise, and QA results to ensure the highest standards of delivery.
AI-First Implementation: Support the company's shift to an AI-first approach by exploring and implementing Agentforce and other Salesforce AI enhancements where applicable. Basic Qualifications:
5+ years in Salesforce development with strong expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Salesforce APIs and integrations (REST/SOAP, middleware like Boomi/Mulesoft)
Proven experience as a Salesforce Dev team Lead for Salesforce Sales, Service, and Revenue Cloud projects
Hands-on experience with CI/CD and Dev Ops tools (e.g., Gearset, Copado, Auto Rabbit)
Experience managing large-scale, multi-team Salesforce releases
Deep understanding of Metadata deployments and dependency management
Experience with Git and version control best practices Desired Qualifications:
Salesforce.com certifications 1 & 2
Working knowledge of Web and Javascript frameworks
Superior written and oral communication skills
Experience in other enterprise platforms is a plus. (Oracle, SAP, Netsuite, AWS)
Proficiency in other code stacks (. Net, Java, Node.js) How You'll Embody Our Core ValuesAt Plative, our core values shape how we work, collaborate, and grow. As part of the team, you will:
Put People First by building trusted relationships with clients and mentoring teammates.
Grow Together, Win Together by sharing knowledge, celebrating wins, and elevating others.
Bring Your Authentic Self to Work by fostering openness, empathy, and integrity in every interaction.
Take the Path You'll Be Proud Of by delivering excellence, owning outcomes, and learning from challenges.
Push Boundaries, Blow Minds by designing creative, scalable solutions that drive real impact. What Happens Next?We know that applying for a new role takes time and energy. At Plative, every application is thoughtfully reviewed by real people on our Talent Team. We aim to review applications within 2 weeks. If we think your skills align with what we're looking for, we'll be in touch to connect further!

description:
*****Please attach your ENGLISH resume to be considered
*****Proficiency/Bilingual in English is a MUST
*****Job location Brazil (Remote)
*****Full time contractor (8 hrs shifts)
*****A Knowledge TEST will be done
Company Description
Bucksense, Inc. is the programmatic platform for advertisers and agencies looking to bring brand building in-house. With a presence in Europe and USA, we are a global team of dedicated people drawn from diverse backgrounds, young and energetic who are passionate about bringing color solutions to the industry we serve. To consistently deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients, we only hire the best talents and nurture their professional growth on exciting projects.
We are looking for a Next.js developer to work in a full-service global customer experience and commerce agency. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our Engineering team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.
Responsibilities
Develop quality software and web applications.
Analyze and maintain existing software applications.
Design highly scalable, testable code.
Discover and fix programming bugs. Qualifications
3+ years of Next.js experience.
3+ years of professional experience developing production-ready web applications.
Ownership of work from beginning to end.
Proficiency in developing web applications and understanding of Java Script and React frameworks.
Experience with headless CMS (i.e. Sanity) is a PLUS.
Programming: HTML, Java Script, PHP.
Operational systems: Linux, Windows. What do we offer?
Remote working.
Work with international clients and colleagues.
Career growth in a constant learning environment.

title: Digital marketing manager
description:
Company DescriptionEDM SAP Solution Provide is a forward-thinking company specializing in delivering innovative solutions that help organizations optimize their processes. With a strong focus on providing high-quality services, we aim to empower businesses with the tools and technologies needed to thrive in today's digital landscape. Our commitment to excellence and client success positions us as a trusted partner in achieving business goals. As a team, we value collaboration, innovation, and a passion for driving impactful results. Role Description
This is a part-time remote role for a Digital Marketing Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, executing, and managing marketing campaigns across digital platforms to enhance brand visibility, generate leads, and drive engagement. Day-to-day tasks include social media marketing, analyzing web analytics to measure campaign performance, developing digital strategies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to meet marketing objectives. Qualifications
Expertise in Social Media Marketing with a track record of successfully managing and growing social media channels.
Experience in Lead Generation and devising strategies to attract and convert potential customers.
Solid foundation in Marketing theory and practices, with a focus on digital platforms.
Proficiency in Web Analytics tools to measure and assess campaign performance, such as Google Analytics.
Extensive knowledge of Digital Marketing, including SEO, SEM, and content marketing strategies.
Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
Experience in B2 B marketing or technology sectors is a plus.

title: Meitu campus ambassador (analytics track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship
We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.
● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.
We're looking for someone who is:
● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.
● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.
● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.
Bonus if you have:
● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).
● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.
What You'll Get
Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team
● Early access to product features and training sessions
● Workshops on social media, product, or design
Rewards & Credit System
We'll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!
Redeem credits for:
● Annual Meitu products membership
● " Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador" Certificate + internship reference
● Meitu Special Deisgn
● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership
● Summer Internship Offer
● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)
About Meitu
Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.
Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357. HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Analista de marketing digital
description:
Localização: Remoto
Tipo de contratação: Tempo integral
Sobre a oportunidade
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Marketing Digital para apoiar a execução e o acompanhamento de iniciativas de marketing em canais digitais.
Esta posição é indicada para profissionais que possuem familiaridade com rotinas de marketing digital e desejam atuar em um ambiente estruturado, com foco em organização, consistência e acompanhamento de resultados. O objetivo é contribuir para a execução adequada das campanhas e suporte às atividades do dia a dia.
Responsabilidades
Apoiar a execução de campanhas de marketing digital em diferentes canais.
Acompanhar métricas de desempenho e organizar informações relacionadas às campanhas.
Auxiliar na análise de dados para identificação de oportunidades de melhoria.
Contribuir com a preparação de relatórios e acompanhamento de resultados.
Apoiar a organização de atividades e fluxos de trabalho.
Colaborar com a equipe para garantir a execução consistente das iniciativas.
Seguir processos internos e manter a organização das atividades.

Experiência ou conhecimento em marketing digital.
Familiaridade com canais digitais e campanhas online.
Boa organização e atenção aos detalhes.
Perfil analítico e interesse em acompanhamento de métricas.
Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.
Ambiente de trabalho
Modelo remoto.
Processos estruturados com suporte interno.
Ambiente colaborativo e profissional.

title: Gerente de marketing digital
description:
Estamos buscando candidatos para uma vaga em Marketing Digital em um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com muitas oportunidades de crescimento. Você será responsável por criar e implementar campanhas de marketing em plataformas digitais como Facebook, Google, Tik Tok e outros canais de mídia. O trabalho inclui planejamento de conteúdo, gestão de anúncios, monitoramento do desempenho das campanhas e otimização de custos para atingir os objetivos de negócios.
Os candidatos ideais devem ser criativos, proativos e possuir fortes habilidades em análise de dados. Experiência em marketing digital é uma vantagem, mas também damos as boas-vindas a jovens apaixonados e com vontade de aprender. É necessário ter excelentes habilidades de redação de conteúdo, conhecimento básico de SEO, publicidade online e ferramentas de marketing.
Oferecemos salário competitivo, bônus por desempenho e oportunidades claras de crescimento na carreira. Além disso, você receberá treinamento de desenvolvimento profissional e trabalhará em uma equipe amigável e colaborativa. Se você ama marketing e deseja construir uma carreira sólida, candidate-se hoje mesmo.

title: Technical implementation specialist
description:
Why Kodif?
At Kodif, we're transforming how customers interact with e Commerce brands. From shopping to support to retention, we're building agentic AI systems that make every website interaction personalized, instant, and human-like — redefining the modern customer journey.
Highlights:
Our team comes from Uber, Meta, Stanford, and Walmart. Our CTO built Uber's customer support platform.
We're backed by Bling Capital, SNR (Kevin Mahaffey), and Village Global (backed by Jeff Bezos, Bill Gates, and Reid Hoffman), with $9 M raised to date.
We're trusted by leading e Commerce brands like Dollar Shave Club, Liquid I. V., Trust Wallet, and Alma. Our Culture & Values:
At Kodif, our values guide how we work, what we build, and how we grow together:
Make It Simple – Build systems that are clear, reliable, and scalable.
Superhuman Speed ️ – Move fast and own the outcome — design, build, and deploy in days, not weeks.
Extreme Ownership – Take end-to-end responsibility for delivering impact, not just features.
Customer Crazy – We obsess over creating delightful, human-like AI experiences for our customers.
Two Steps Ahead – Anticipate issues before they surface. Design for the future.
Row Together – Collaborate, communicate, and ship together — success at Kodif is a team sport. Position Overview:
The Technical Implementation Specialist focuses on implementation of AI automation workflows, technical troubleshooting, product behavior analysis, and technical issue resolution. This role combines proactive customer management with technical troubleshooting, enabling Kodif's customers to maximize the value of our platform.
The Implementation Specialist will work cross-functionally to resolve issues, identify risks, and help customers succeed with the Kodif platform.
Responsibilities:
Partner with customers to align product adoption strategies with business goals.
Monitor customer communication channels to identify issues, resolve them, and escalate to Tier 2 technical support when needed.
Identify and mitigate risks related to usage, adoption, or critical defects by creating and executing targeted action plans.
Initiate and manage escalation processes, coordinating communication between customers and internal teams.
Support post-mortem analyses for escalations or major incidents.
Relay customer feedback to product and engineering to influence roadmap priorities.
Address concerns early to reduce churn risk and support long-term retention.
Support internal teams with technical insights and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting guides, and product improvements. Requirements:
Experience in Support, Implementation, or Customer Success (preferably in AI or CX Saa S).
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills (no coding required).
Strong technical acumen and ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of building trust and advocating for customers.
Experience with ticketing systems, Slack-based support, or similar communication tools.
Experience with LLM prompting.
Ability to read and interpret JSON (e.g., identify failed integration calls and relevant fields). Nice to have:
Ability to interpret SQL-level data and database-driven summaries (light query writing may be required).
Ability to read Python-related error messages and escalate appropriately (no direct coding required). Compensation & Benefits:
Competitive salary based on location and work experience.
Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, product, and customer experience with real business impact.
Opportunity to build one of the most impactful AI systems in e Commerce. To be considered, please complete this short application form (2–3 minutes): YYr6 UDG4m RB9 SMt9 and then apply here as well.
